# Response Debug formatting preserves raw bytes and does not select every error log body

Response stores Vec<u8>, and body() returns its byte slice. Its Debug implementation borrows those bytes, formats them as text when core::str::from_utf8 succeeds, and falls back to byte-vector formatting when it fails. It does not change response storage, status classification or protocol parsing. Error::StatusCode retains Response, but its Display message contains only the HTTP status. The checked shared sender formats an ordinary status error with {err}; it uses {err:?} for another unexpected-error branch. Do not assume a prettier Response Debug formatter makes every failure log include the body. This is a static formatter and caller distinction; no new HTTP or formatting test ran.

Scope: rust/moz_http.
